messages:
devin: Heads-up — after the connector split rollout this morning some tenant previews show ~3-4% lower token counts than final invoices for the same time window. Not sure if it's duplication suppression, late-acked events, or missing enrichment. Anyone seeing related alerts?
irina: I noticed a small bump in duplicate dedupe drops around the same deploy time. Could be the splitter changing event keys. Will pull logs.
mike: Confirmed in logs: splitter emits header `x-routing-hash` but downstream dedupe used `fingerprint_v1` which the old connector set; new one sometimes leaves it blank. Example log: `WARN dedupe: missing fingerprint_v1 tenant=acme span=0ms`
tara: Oof. That explains missing dedupe -> lower counted tokens? Wait, missing fingerprint should cause more duplicates to pass, which would inflate counts not reduce them.
jess: Right — duplicate pass would bump previews up. The problem here is previews low vs final high. So maybe previews run against the shadow pipeline (pre-enrich) while final uses enriched tokens after delayed postproc. Splitter might be routing enriched events to final but not to preview stream.
devin: Good point. Our preview mode subscribes to `events.preview` — splitter has new routing rules that tag `preview:true` only when the request header `x-preview` exists. But some SDK clients send preview via query param and splitter lost that during transform.
irina: I ran a quick query against the staging read model: `select count(*) from tokens where tenant='acme' and ts between '2026-02-01' and '2026-02-01' group by pipeline_stage;` shows 92k tokens in preview-stage vs 96k in final-stage for that tenant.
mike: Patch suggestion: make splitter copy `x-preview` into event.metadata.preview when present in any of header/query/ctx so routing is consistent. Small change, can roll in a canary.
tara: Before we roll, can we reproduce locally end-to-end? I can spin a mini-cluster and run old vs new connector with the same batch of requests. If we can reproduce, we should add an integration test asserting parity within tolerance.
jess: Also update the console UX: preview invoices should show a note when we detect a connector-version mismatch that may affect preview fidelity. That'll reduce ops noise.
devin: Agree on both. Who wants the canary? Mike you ok to own quick splitter patch and canary (low-risk deploy policy: 3% traffic -> 30m -> 10%)?
mike: Yep. I'll open a PR and tag `eng-platform` and `billing`. PR will include the metadata copy and an extra field `router_version` for easier tracing.
irina: I'll prepare queries for before/after diff and a Grafana panel comparing `preview_token_count / final_token_count` by tenant. If ratio drops under 0.98 we alert.
tara: I'll do the local end-to-end. If we can run a replay tool to produce identical input to both connectors that'd be ideal — I have a tiny harness already.
jess: Also loop in billing ops for the 24h window after canary to avoid automated charge corrections while we validate. They can hold auto-adjust jobs.
ingest-bot: deploy-canary started by mike on splitter-service (version: 2026-02-01-splitter-a1) -> canary target: 3% traffic. CI: passed.
mike: Canary up. I'm watching canary logs; no obvious panics but I see a handful of `metadata.preview` values stuck as `null` for legacy SDKs — will add fallback to pull from `query_params.preview`.
devin: Great. After 30m canary let's compare the Grafana panel (irina) + sample tenant diffs (tara). If parity within 1%, we promote. If not, rollback and we ship the test + patch.
jess: Filing follow-up item: add a contract check in router integration tests that validates that preview routing key is preserved across transforms. I'll create ticket PLATFORM-1289 and link PRs.
irina: Ticket created and linked. Panel: https://grafana.internal/r/preview-vs-final (read-only until billing ops gives access)
tara: Local repro succeeded with the harness — splitter lost query param in 2/50k events under the older proxy shape. Patch handles that.
mike: Rolling promo to 30% now (gradual). Monitoring ratio and dedupe drops.
devin: Thanks all. If anything goes sideways ping @oncall. We'll keep billing ops paused for auto-corrections until tomorrow 00:00 UTC.
jess: :thumbsup:
